headwords.text:
To see stones in your dreams, foretells numberless perplexities and failures.

To walk among rocks, or stones, omens that an uneven and rough pathway will be yours for at least a while.

To make deals in ore-bearing rock lands, you will be successful in business after many lines have been tried. If you fail to profit by the deal, you will have disappointments. If anxiety is greatly felt in closing the trade, you will succeed in buying or selling something that will prove profitable to you.

Small stones or pebbles, implies that little worries and vexations will irritate you.

If you throw a stone, you will have cause to admonish a person.

If you design to throw a pebble or stone at some belligerent person, it denotes that some evil feared by you will pass because of your untiring attention to right principles.
headwords.note: 기존 stone(돌)에 문맥 6개 추가 — 광석 땅 거래 문단(세 조건절)은 하나로 묶음

headwords.text:
To see stone masons at work while dreaming, foretells disappointment.

To dream that you are a stone mason, portends that your labors will be unfruitful, and your companions will be dull and uncongenial.
headwords.note: 기존 mason(석공)에 문맥 1개 추가. 첫 문장(석공이 일하는 것을 봄)은 기존 mason의 「석공이 일하는 것을 봄」(밀러 Mason 헤드워드, 길함)과 같은 그림·다른 풀이라 건너뜀

headwords.text: To dream of a storage battery, opportune speculations will return you handsome gains.

To dream of a store filled with merchandise, foretells prosperity and advancement.

An empty one, denotes failure of efforts and quarrels.

To dream that your store is burning, is a sign of renewed activity in business and pleasure.

If you find yourself in a department store, it foretells that much pleasure will be derived from various sources of profit.

To sell goods in one, your advancement will be accelerated by your energy and the efforts of friends.

To dream that you sell a pair of soiled, gray cotton gloves to a woman, foretells that your opinion of women will place you in hazardous positions.  If a woman has this dream, her preference for some one of the male sex will not be appreciated very much by him.
headwords.note: 기존 shop(가게)에 문맥 7개 추가 — shop의 옛 유일한 의미(「가게 꿈을 꿈」, 밀러 Shop 헤드워드)와는 다른 헤드워드라 안 겹침

headwords.text: To see and hear a storm approaching, foretells continued sickness, unfavorable business, and separation from friends, which will cause added distress.  If the storm passes, your affliction will not be so heavy.
headwords.note: 기존 hurricane(태풍)의 「태풍이 몰려오는 것을 봄」(밀러 Hurricane 헤드워드)과 같은 그림·다른 풀이라 통째로 건너뜀 — 원문 각주 [214] See Hurricane and Rain가 그 뜻이다

headwords.text:
If you dream of straw, your life is threatened with emptiness and failure.

To see straw piles burning, is a signal of prosperous times.

To feed straw to stock, foretells that you will make poor provisions for those depending upon you.
